text:
anika: Hey team — opened a small cleanup/refactor PR that moves serializer helpers into a new pkg/io package and normalizes function names. Mostly mechanical but would appreciate extra eyes for style and public API surface. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/refs/pull/4823

anika: Summary:
- moved: src/serializers/* -> src/io/serializers/*
- renamed: serializePayload -> encodePayload, deserializePayload -> decodePayload
- split tests into unit vs integration
- updated imports across runtime and tests

anika: Example change: ```js
- const { serializePayload } = require('../serializers')
+ const { encodePayload } = require('../io/serializers')
```

anika: CI ran locally for me, but want someone to check: 1) the rename safety across public packages, 2) style/linters, 3) any subtle runtime implications for the cache key generation.

jess: Thanks — will take a look after standup, should be able to review in the afternoon :+1:

sam: quick Q: why the rename to encode/decode? was serialize/deserialize causing ambiguity with other modules?

anika: yep — serialize was overloaded in a couple packages (network serializers vs storage). encode/decode feels clearer for the binary/kv path. No behavioural change besides name and import path.

mike: heads up I noticed one lint failure in the commits (trailing comma in src/io/serializers/index.js) — CI should catch but if you want I can push a fix to the branch.

anika: thanks — feel free to push the lint fix. also opened the PR with draft changelog entry so product can review if they want.

jess: skimming now. will comment on any public API exposures. if none, we can merge once CI green and one more approval.

ci-bot: CI passed (unit tests) — build #4823.2 — commits: 7c9a4b2

sam: If we keep the old require paths for a deprecation cycle, could we add a small passthrough that logs a debug deprecation? not required but could ease upgrades.

anika: considered it, but wanted to avoid keeping duplicate exports indefinitely. happy to add a temporary passthrough with console.debug if folks prefer.

mike: +1 for passthrough debug entry for one release, helps infra teams.

jess: agree. add a TODO in the file and a short note in the PR description about timeline for removal.

anika: done — pushed a small passthrough with debug log and updated PR description. PTAL when you get a chance.

jess: left 2 small comments about naming in the public index file, mostly nitpicks. overall looks good.

sam: approved — left one comment asking for a test that ensures cache key composition unaffected.

mike: LGTM, approved.

anika: thanks all — merging once CI completes and I get +1 from jess. will follow up on the removal timeline in the team doc. :rocket:
